learning_outcomes.text: understand the fundamental principles of linear algebra, especially the importance of linear structures and algorithms
can recognize and describe connections to their own discipline
know basic mathematical knowledge for further study
can follow mathematical working methods (developing mathematical intuition and its formal justification, understanding the rigorous axiomatic structure of mathematical fields)
can discuss linear algebra content in a structured way within a group

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of logic and set theory
Representation of linear mappings, change of basis
assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises must be achieved. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program.
bibliography: Dörfler,W. ; Peschek,W. : Einführung in die Mathematik für Informatiker, Hanser
Pareigis,B. : Lineare Algebra für Informatiker, Springer
